subject_name: Ethics in IT_Đạo đức trong CNTT

meta.Syllabus Name: Ethics in IT_Đạo đức trong CNTT
meta.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 128h online + 3h offline + 1h TE + 18h self-study
meta.Description: Organizations and governments are seeking out ethics professionals to minimize risk and guide their decision-making about the design of inclusive, responsible, and trusted technology. An algorithm not designed and assessed in alignment with ethical standards can create further inequity across race, gender and marginalized populations. The reputational and financial impact of an ethics violation can devastate a company. Knowledgeable ethics leaders are needed who can navigate through the more than 160 frameworks and guidelines to select and implement the best strategy to promote fairness and minimize risk for their organization. This specialization is designed for learners who want to create and lead initiatives that prioritize ethical integrity within emerging data-driven technology fields such as artificial intelligence and data science and will be prepared to bridge the gap between theory and practice.
meta.StudentTasks:
Student must get the following certificatations to be accepted to the final examination:
- Certification of CertNexus Certified Ethical Emerging Technologist Professional Certificate (CertNexus) specialization
- Certification of Ethics of Artificial Intelligence course
meta.Note:
1. Complete the online courses and get all certifications to be allowed to take Final Exam
2. Final Exam included Final Theory Exam (TE): 100%
3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & (Final TE Score + bonus) >= 5
